full_prompt_en: A square, richly colored comic-style illustration shows two stocky helmeted men crouching face to face on a worn stone street. Behind them, a rough tan wall and a dark recessed wooden doorway fill the background. The doorway rises between their heads, framed by irregular masonry blocks that are carefully shaded along each edge. On the left, an older-looking figure wears a silver-blue helmet, a red shoulder cloth, muted green clothing, heavy brown boots, and a wide belt with a gold round clasp. White hair projects beneath the helmet, and a thick white moustache curves over his mouth. His oversized orange nose and round ears give the face a comic exaggeration. He rests folded arms on one raised knee and turns his eyes toward the figure opposite him. The man on the right wears a dark metal helmet topped by a high red plume. Yellow hair and a long yellow moustache fall around a similarly large orange nose. A vivid teal-blue outfit gathers at the knees, and reddish brown shoes press against the uneven ground. He squats with both forearms forward, looking intently at the other man. Small metal discs and a reddish pack sit near his right side. Warm sunlight from the upper right strikes the wall, faces, hands, and cobbled foreground, while the doorway and recesses remain deep brown. Fine dark outlines describe fingers, folds, helmet rims, and the separations between stone blocks. Painted shading adds roundness to cheeks and limbs, but the silhouettes retain an emphatic cartoon clarity. The palette contrasts orange skin and sandy stone with deep teal clothing, crimson cloth, and bright yellow hair. No dialogue balloons or readable words appear in this image. The overall composition is a close, humorous encounter, with mirrored crouching poses and expressive features anchoring the detailed old-stone setting.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、色彩浓郁的漫画式插画：两个敦实、戴头盔的男子在磨旧的石街上面对面蹲着。身后，粗糙的浅褐石墙和深陷的木门占据背景。门洞在两人头部之间升起，不规则石块围住它，每一条边都经过仔细明暗描绘。左边较显年长的人戴银蓝头盔、披红色肩布、穿低调绿色衣服和厚重褐靴，腰上有一条带金色圆扣的宽腰带。白发从头盔下露出，浓密白胡子在嘴上弯曲。夸张的大橙色鼻子和圆耳朵赋予脸部漫画感。他把交叠手臂放在抬起的膝上，眼睛转向对面的人。右边男子戴深金属色头盔，顶部竖着高高的红色羽饰。黄发和长长黄胡子垂在同样巨大的橙色鼻子两旁。鲜明的蓝绿色衣服在膝部堆褶，红褐鞋子踩在不平地面上。他蹲着，双臂向前，专注地看着另一人。小金属圆片和一个偏红的背包位于其右侧附近。暖阳从右上照亮墙壁、面孔、双手和铺石前景，门洞及凹处则保持深褐色。细密深色轮廓描绘手指、衣褶、盔沿和石块缝隙。绘画式明暗让脸颊与四肢更圆润，但剪影保留鲜明漫画式清晰度。配色以橙色皮肤、沙色石头对照深蓝绿衣物、深红布料和亮黄头发。画中没有对话框或可读文字。整体构图是一场贴近的幽默相遇，镜像般的蹲姿和夸张表情稳住细节丰富的旧石环境。
style_prompt_en: Richly painted comic illustration combines elastic, exaggerated rounded forms with carefully described material surfaces. Dark, confident contours keep gestures and silhouettes clear, while smaller interior lines articulate folds, seams, and rough textures. Warm oranges and ochres dominate the lit areas; saturated cool blues and reds provide strong opposing accents. Directional sunlight brightens broad exposed planes, and recessed gaps turn deep brown, giving cartoon shapes convincing weight without losing their graphic energy. Close framing and paired visual masses create a lively exchange across the center. The overall appearance is humorous, tactile, and highly legible, with detailed painted shading inside emphatic outlines.
style_prompt_zh: 色彩浓郁的绘画式漫画插画将有弹性、夸张圆润的形体与认真描绘的材质表面结合。深色而自信的轮廓保持动作和剪影清晰，较小的内部线条则刻画褶皱、接缝和粗糙肌理。受光区域以暖橙和赭色为主，饱和冷蓝与红色形成有力的对比强调。定向阳光照亮宽阔外露平面，凹陷缝隙转为深褐色，使卡通形体有可信重量，却不失图形动势。近距离画框和成对视觉块面使中心形成活跃交流。整体外观幽默、可触且易辨，在鲜明轮廓内部容纳细致绘画明暗。
theme_en: Two helmeted comic figures crouching together on a stone street
theme_zh: 两个戴头盔的漫画人物在石街上面对面蹲着
name: The Adventures of Asterix
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
